result.rationale: Statement [1] explicitly derives the phase exponent −x1+x2+x7 and notes it must equal ℓ as an integer, exposing the mismatch between the real-valued exponent arithmetic and the mod-2 definitions used for x1,x2,x7, which is exactly the annotated defect.
